title: Will the Real Linda Please Stand Up...to Large Language Models? Examining the Representativeness Heuristic in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs using the REHEAT dataset, which consists of multiple-choice and ranking questions designed to test susceptibility to the representativeness heuristic. The questions pit statistical probability against intuitive, prototype-driven reasoning across six cognitive fallacies (Base Rate Fallacy, Conjunction Fallacy, Disjunction Fallacy, Insensitivity to Sample Size, Misconceptions of Chance, and Regression Fallacy).

Conducting qualitative case studies using counter-intuitive scenarios involving gender stereotypes (e.g., explicit text stating girls are more likely to play sports and boys are more likely to do theater) to observe whether LLMs override explicit base-rate information with ingrained social assumptions during chain-of-thought reasoning.
